scope: Targeted public-source checks for the three candidates that passed G0 reference-only. Portal listings are asking/supply signals, not completed leases, transaction evidence, unique demand counts, or unit verification.

sources.title: Kuala Lumpur Campus — About the Campus
observed_claims: The Kuala Lumpur campus is at 1 Jalan UCSI, UCSI Heights (Taman Connaught), Cheras.
The campus page describes a campus population above 15,000 and student residential halls, alongside academic and student facilities.
limits: Does not measure how many students or staff rent outside campus.
Does not prove Riana South is walkable, preferred, occupied by UCSI users, or attractive to owner-buyers.

sources.title: Riana South, Bukit Manda'rina
observed_claims: Identifies Riana South at Jalan Mandarina Damai 1.
Lists UCSI shuttle waiting locations at 0.3 km and UCSI campus wings at 0.4 km.
limits: Distance method and usable pedestrian route were not independently verified.
Directory text is not an actual tenancy or proof of demand.

sources.title: Riana South 947 sq ft 3BR rental advertisement
observed_claims: Page showed a 947 sq ft, 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit with two parking bays advertised at RM3,300/month and a stated move-in date of 15 October 2026.
limits: Asking advertisement only; the stated move-in date had passed by access date. Treat occupancy/current availability as unknown; do not use as collected rent or a fresh independent observation.

sources.title: PJ Midtown Commercial
observed_claims: Locates PJ Midtown in Section 13, Petaling Jaya and describes the area as a residential/commercial hub with highway access.
limits: Developer description; does not establish office occupancy, employer counts, commute time, achieved rents, or buyer demand.

sources.title: PJ Midtown Commercial eBrochure (February 2024)
observed_claims: Describes PJ Midtown as a mixed commercial/residential development with office and retail components in Section 13.
limits: Marketing/project-use evidence only; no current tenant directory, office absorption or demand measurement.

sources.title: Kelana Mahkota rental results
observed_claims: The page showed 1,260 sq ft, 3-bedroom rental advertisements around RM2,300-RM2,500/month, with dates around 28-29 September 2026.
Several rows had the same size and price and could be reposts/duplicates; count them as one asking cluster, not independent leases.
The page lists nearby local bus stops, schools, medical care and grocery/retail options.
limits: Ads do not prove occupancy, achieved rent, unique units, absorption, affordability, or a buyer path.
The page also labels 'SS7 station' about 200 m away and calls it an upcoming rail link; station type and identity are unresolved and are excluded from this G1 mechanism.

sources.title: Kelana Mahkota property results
observed_claims: Shows marketed 1,260 sq ft three-bedroom rental offers around RM2,300/month and identifies the project on Jalan SS 7/19.
Lists everyday amenities including medical care, schools, grocery/retail, parks and transit options; page displayed sale and rent advertisements.
limits: Portal counts and amenities are unverified and can change; listings are not completed transactions, occupied units, or evidence of repeat demand.

sources.title: Rapid On-Demand service expansion announcement
observed_claims: The document identifies Taman Bahagia Station–SS6/SS7 as a Rapid On-Demand service area/extension.
limits: This supports an on-demand bus connection, not a rail station at SS7 or a measured walk from Kelana Mahkota. Route, service hours and current availability still need direct verification.

sources.title: Klang Valley Integrated Transit Map
observed_claims: The map names rail stations such as Glenmarie, Lembah Subang, Ara Damansara and Taman Bahagia; it does not identify an SS7 rail station.
limits: Older map issue and not a current route planner. Used only as a cross-check against an ambiguous portal label, not to assert present service or walking distance.
